blocker.RECORD_NOT_COMPLETE: This record is not a complete Product record, and Thoth creates only from complete records. Leave it out of this import to continue.
blocker.RECORD_NOTIFICATION_UNRECOGNISED: This record's NotificationType is missing or not one ONIX defines, so what it asks for is unknown.
blocker.RECORD_SEQUENCE_AMBIGUITY: Records of different kinds describe the same Product, so their order in the file would decide the result. Leave out the records that are not complete to continue.
blocker.PRODUCT_RECORD_CONFLICT: Several records describe the same Product differently.
blocker.ISBN_AMBIGUOUS: The Product declares more than one valid ISBN-13, so its ISBN is unknown.
blocker.MULTIPLE_WORK_IDENTITIES: Products grouped as one Work name different Works.
blocker.ALTERNATIVE_FORMAT_AMBIGUOUS: An alternative format points at more than one Product in this file.
blocker.WORK_DOI_CONFLICT: Products grouped as one Work state different Work DOIs.
blocker.THOTH_PROFILE_INCONSISTENT: This record carries Thoth's export identifiers inconsistently, so they cannot be used.
blocker.THOTH_WORK_ID_CONFLICT: Products grouped as one Work carry different Thoth Work identifiers.
blocker.THOTH_WORK_FIELD_CONFLICT: Products grouped as one Work disagree on a Work field Thoth's export writes on every Product.
blocker.EDITION_CONFLICT: Products grouped as one Work state different edition numbers.
blocker.EDITION_SOURCE_INVALID: The edition number is not a whole number of 1 or more.
blocker.EDITION_UNREPRESENTABLE: The edition number is too large for Thoth to store.
blocker.EDITION_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Products grouped as one Work describe their edition differently.
blocker.EDITION_INPUT_REQUIRED: The file describes a new or revised edition without its number. Enter the edition number.
blocker.MANIFESTATION_INPUT_REQUIRED: The file does not establish one publication type for this Product. Choose one, or create no Publication for it.
blocker.MANIFESTATION_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED: Thoth cannot hold this Product as one Publication. Confirm that no Publication is created for it.
blocker.SAME_TYPE_COLLISION: Several Products of one Work would become the same publication type, which a Work holds only once.
blocker.COMPONENT_UNSUPPORTED: A content item is not a chapter Thoth can create: a complete embedded work, an audiovisual item or an unrecognised item.
blocker.GROUPED_WORK_FACT_CONFLICT: Products grouped as one Work disagree on Work metadata, and nothing may choose between them.
blocker.WORK_TYPE_INPUT_REQUIRED: Choose the work type: nothing in the file decides it.
blocker.WORK_TYPE_PARENT_RELATION_REQUIRED: A book chapter needs the Work it belongs to, which this import cannot create yet.
blocker.WORK_TYPE_OVERRIDE_CONFLICT: The chosen work type differs from the existing Work's own, which this import never changes.
blocker.EXISTING_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS: An identifier matches more than one existing Work in Thoth, or a matched Work could not be read, so the target is unknown.
blocker.CONFLICTING_EXISTING_WORKS: This Work's identifiers match different existing Works in Thoth.
blocker.WRONG_WORK_ISBN: This ISBN already belongs to another Work in Thoth.
blocker.EXISTING_TYPE_COLLISION: The existing Work already has a Publication of this type.
blocker.EXISTING_PUBLICATION_TYPE_CONTRADICTION: The existing Publication with this ISBN has a different publication type in Thoth.
blocker.EXISTING_WORK_CONTRADICTION: The existing Work's own details contradict the file, so nothing is added to it.
blocker.EXISTING_WORK_COMPATIBILITY_UNVERIFIED: This record also describes the Work itself, and that description could not be confirmed against the existing Work, so no Publication is added to it.
blocker.EXISTING_WORK_UNAUTHORIZED: The matched existing Work is not in one of this publisher's imprints.
blocker.ATTACH_TO_EXISTING_WORK_DEFERRED: Adding a Publication to an existing Work is not available yet. Create no Publication for this Product to import the rest of the file.
blocker.THOTH_COMPATIBILITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRE: Confirm whether Thoth exported this file for this publisher before its Thoth identifiers are used.
blocker.THOTH_PROFILE_CONTRADICTED: The file's Thoth identifiers contradict this publisher's records in Thoth.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_CHOICE_REQUIRED: The file leaves a decision about its description open. Answer it under Description decisions.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED: Part of the file’s description cannot be imported. Acknowledge the omission under Description decisions.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_INPUT_REQUIRED: The file does not give descriptive information a new Work needs. Where it can be supplied here, supply it under Description decisions.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_UNREPRESENTABLE: Thoth cannot represent part of the file’s description in a way that lets the Work be created.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_SOURCE_CONFLICT: The file’s description contradicts itself or what is already in Thoth, and nothing may choose between them.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_PREFLIGHT_GAP: Part of the file’s description could not be checked, so nothing is created from it.
blocker.DESCRIPTIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED: Importing part of the file’s description is not available yet.
blocker.EXISTING_WORK_DESCRIPTIVE_CONTRADICTION: This record describes the Work differently from the existing Work in Thoth, which this import never changes.
blocker.RIGHTS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: The file’s rights information contradicts itself, and nothing may choose between its statements.
blocker.RIGHTS_INPUT_REQUIRED: The file’s rights information leaves the Work’s licence undecided, and this import cannot take that decision yet.
blocker.RIGHTS_UNREPRESENTABLE: The file states rights Thoth cannot record, and this import cannot yet acknowledge leaving them out.
blocker.RIGHTS_PREFLIGHT_GAP: Some of the file’s rights information could not be checked, so nothing is created from it.
blocker.COMMERCIAL_INPUT_REQUIRED: The file’s supply information leaves a Publication’s price or location undecided, and this import cannot take that decision yet.
blocker.COMMERCIAL_UNREPRESENTABLE: The file states supply information for a Publication that Thoth cannot record as it stands, and this import cannot yet take the decision it needs.
blocker.COMMERCIAL_PREFLIGHT_GAP: Some of the file’s supply or price information could not be checked, so nothing is created from it.
blocker.COMMERCIAL_CHOICE_REQUIRED: The file leaves a Publication’s price to you: choose one of the prices it states, or to import none.
